concerns.text: T103 validates `artifacts/reports/model_metrics.json` against `contracts/model_results.schema.yaml`, but that JSON is produced by the still-pending T029a–T029d tasks listed later in the completed-work section as unchecked. This is a consumer-before-producer ordering violation: the contract test in Phase 1 cannot pass until the Phase 2/3 metrics producer runs. Either move T103 after T029a–T029d (e.g., into Phase 3, validated as part of T110) or state explicitly that T103's verification is deferred until the metrics artifact exists.

All three Phase-1 tasks are tagged [P] but each appends tests to the SAME file `tests/contract/test_schemas.py`. Concurrent execution creates a write conflict / lost-update hazard on a shared artifact, so the [P] tags are not parallel-safe. Either serialize them (drop [P]) or have each task write a separate test module (e.g., test_dataset_schema.py, test_output_schema.py, test_model_results_schema.py).

T104 instructs the power analysis be computed 'Before filtering', but the species filtering (n≥20) is already listed as completed work, so no pre-filtering execution point exists in the remaining task order. Reword to compute from the raw/unfiltered ingestion output or acknowledge the already-filtered dataset, so the task is executable in the given sequence.
